title: Recipe 73 — The trading advisor: when the market grades your agent

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “An advisor, not a trader — it never places an order. What it does is keep a journal the market grades for it.”

beats.label: Blank the scratch file
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed trader is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the credentials
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — THREDZ_API_KEY for the wiki store, plus the model credential.

beats.label: Open the spec
beats.cue: “A hundred and forty-seven lines: memory, a wiki, a curriculum, and a heartbeat that studies overnight.”

beats.label: Lint it in place
beats.cue: “Clean. Every part of the learning loop is a declared field.”

beats.label: Type the store line
beats.cue: “The wiki store is where a lesson survives the session that taught it.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Hosted or local — the spec doesn't care which, and neither does the loop.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Read the memory and knowledge nodes — the studying apparatus, as IR.”

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “No trading primitives anywhere in here. It's an agent that writes things down.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, stopped at the MCP server credential the spec itself declares. A named gate, not a failure.”

verify.note: GREEN — boot gated (boot reached its MCP server credentials gate: THREDZ_API_KEY)

beats.label: Type the heartbeat
beats.cue: “study/reflect on a schedule — the difference between an advisor and a search box.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Overnight, unattended, and bounded. All three matter.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · the journal is the dataset

beats.label: Look for the journal dataset
beats.cue: “The market's grade arrives later than the advice does. Until then, the registry is empty — and says so.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “That lag is the honest, hard part of this recipe: you cannot grade today's call today.”

beats.label: Compile the study daemon
beats.cue: “The daemon is a second spec — the thing that studies while nobody's watching.”

beats.label: Read the output
beats.cue: “Two bundles: the advisor you talk to, and the student that reads overnight.”

groups.title: One more thing · ask it something real

beats.label: Run the advisor
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Ask the recipe's own question. Note what it does with the numbers it isn't sure about.”

verify.note: needs THREDZ_API_KEY and a model credential

beats.label: Ask about a round trip
beats.cue: [needs-key] “It writes the reasoning to the journal — which is what makes it gradeable next month.”
beats.text: What would a round trip on 50 shares cost me, and what am I actually betting on?

beats.label: Exit
beats.cue: [needs-key] “exit” returns to the shell.

beats.label: Distill the journal
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Once outcomes are known, the journal becomes a dataset and the flywheel has something true to optimize against.”

verify.note: billed judge pass; only meaningful once outcomes are known
